dz: 济州航空2216号班机在韩国穆安撞入一堵墙,造成181名乘客中179人死亡. 这是韩国历史上最严重的飞机事故.
de: Jeju Air Flight 2216 crashes into a wall in Muan, South Korea, killing 179 of the 181 occupants. It is the worst aircraft accident on South Korean soil in history.
